notes.title: Dead Reset OUT NOW
notes.content: [p][i]Dead Reset[/i] is an interactive horror where death is not the end, but the key to survival. Guide Cole Mason, a surgeon trapped in a [b]deadly loop[/b], through moral choices, eerie encounters, and fractured alliances. Each choice steers your fate as death unlocks new paths. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="UR8jIHIJIF4;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][p][b]Death is Inevitable [/b][/p][p]Master the death-loop to uncover the path to escape. Death is not the end but offers a terrifying new perspective. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Embrace the Horror [/b][/p][p]Immerse yourself in a blood-soaked, interactive narrative with cinematic scares, bloody practical effects and high-stakes choice-driven gameplay that put you at the heart of a relentless sci-fi horror movie.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Choices Matter [/b][/p][p]Steer Cole on a path of Redemption or Damnation in your fight to survive. There are no easy choices as your morality is tested at every turn and your decisions will result in four wildly different endings.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Pause the Terror [/b][/p][p]Playing to an audience? Enable Streamer Mode, which removes time constraints on choices, letting your viewers guide Cole’s fate and delight in his gruesome deaths.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Who Do You Trust? [/b][/p][p]Build trust or fracture alliances; each bond forged or broken influences your road to survival. View the in-game tracker to check your relationship with other characters, if they are still alive.[/p][p][/p][p][b]A message from the film director, Stewart Sparke...[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]"Dead Reset was designed to get under the skin of the player and deliver relentless scares driven by gruesome practical effects and a time-bending descent into terror. I can't wait for people to dive in and play our blood-drenched, interactive love letter to the horror genre!" [/i][/p][p][/p][p]Developed by Wales Interactive and Dark Rift Horror.[/p][p]Published by Wales Interactive[/p][p]Film production by Dark Rift Horror.[/p]

notes.title: OUT NOW | The Isle Tide Hotel
notes.content:
Today is the grand opening of The Isle Tide Hotel! Expect a live-action, interactive mystery movie about an absent father who must rescue his teenage daughter from an eclectic cult before their final night at the Isle Tide Hotel. 

Think a British Twin Peaks with a Wes Anderson aesthetic! Or, if that doesn't convince you, how about a grittier Knives Out? There's so much to explore and discover about The Isle Tide Hotel that one playthrough won't get close to telling the whole story.

[previewyoutube=_lSv_RQkKi8;full][/previewyoutube]

Why is your daughter estranged in the first place? Will you join the cult to save her? How will you interact with the bizarre people you meet? Each playthrough of The Isle Tide Hotel's branching narrative will be completely different, with seven main endings in your mission to rescue the daughter you've never met. Just remember… don't break the Etiquettes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/9c782eeaef7589cd09a03a1731c10d20a6bd524d.jpg[/img]

Created by brother-sister director-producer combo Harry and Grace Chadwick of Interflix Media, the themes of The Isle Tide Hotel draw on the transformational journey of parenthood and the unique paths that can be taken when dealing with family dynamics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/0c5302aecad1055167a43dac51c405e601a451b2.jpg[/img]

You don't want to miss our biggest production yet, with a cast including UK icons from shows including Game of Thrones, Call the Midwife and Happy Valley.

It's our biggest project yet. Every decision affects the story and you'll have to keep an eye out for clues - it's on you if you miss something important.

[b]The Isle Tide Hotel is OUT NOW on PC, Epic, Mac, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series S|X, Nintendo Switch, iOS, and Android[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/a59eb786b5c4cf1285589db297e8668aeb4228a6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Mia and the Dragon Princess OUT NOW
notes.content:
Wales Interactive, have launched interactive, buddy-action movie Mia and the Dragon Princess. Unravel the mystery with Mia, a plucky bartender whose life is thrown into chaos when a mysterious woman turns up at her workplace, on the run from a group of violent thugs.

[previewyoutube=0YcSREYCCP4;full][/previewyoutube]

Mia and the Dragon Princess is now available on PC, Epic, Mac, PS5, PS4, Xbox One, Series X|S, Switch, iOS and Android. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42624485/d3b531790787863a5029bc76b71f6dd0657e301f.jpg[/img]

 
[b]Features[/b]
•	Featuring action designed by world-renowned fight coordinator, Marcus Shakesheff (WonderWoman, Hanna, Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows, Batman: Arkham Asylum, Pennyworth, Guardians of the Galaxy, Game of Thrones)
•	Featuring fight stunts by Taekwondo instructor and content creator with over 700M views, Aaron Gassor aka 'Ginger Ninja Trickster'
•	Real time Attribute Tracking that evolves based on your choices and influences the story
•	Multi-optional storytelling with 10 different outcomes
•	Starring Paul McGann (Doctor Who, Alien 3, Withnail & I), Brian McCardie (Time, Rob Roy) and MyAnna Buring (The Witcher, Ripper Street), Dita Tantang and Noa Bleeker.
•	Guest appearance by Daz Black (DazGames) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42624485/e46595f81fd3686eea42fd4630eabf884dea18f6.jpg[/img]

[b]Synopsis[/b]

Mia dreams of adventure, but her feeling of responsibility to her workmates – who have become her surrogate family – keeps her working at a job she’s bored of, living a life she didn’t want. When a mysterious woman (Marshanda) turns up scared and on the run, Mia’s decision to take her under her wing and try to discover her identity leads her down a path of intrigue, mystery and danger. 
 
When a group of thugs, led by the quietly terrifying, Walsh (Paul McGann) turns up at the bar, Mia and her co-workers are taken hostage along with a group of customers. When Mia’s boss, Matthew (Brian McCardie) is injured, the stakes are raised and the struggle becomes real when Mia and the group end up on the run and battling for their lives. 
 
The viewer’s choices will guide Mia through the adventure and will determine her fate, as well as that of the whole group. Throughout the game, your interactions could increase your knowledge around the identity of the mysterious woman, but the way Mia deals with the rest of the group will also have an impact, so each choice needs to be carefully considered.   

[b]Mia and the Dragon Princess is published by Wales Interactive and developed by Wales Interactive, Good Gate Media and Dead Pixel Productions. [/b]

notes.title: Maid of Sker | Make Your Reservation at Sker Hotel on July 28
notes.content:
[h1] Make your Reservation at the Sker Hotel! [/h1]

[b] Join us for the hotel's Grand Re-opening on July 28th, pre-order from July 21st on PC, PS4 and Xbox One. [/b]

Introducing the new trailer for Maid of Sker featuring the spine-chilling voice of Tia Kalmaru with a re-imagining of a traditional Welsh lullaby Calon Lan.

Maid of Sker is a first-person survival horror, set in a remote hotel with a gory and macabre history from British folklore. At Sker Hotel we offer grotesque views, eerie forest trails, and blood-soaked beds. Be our guest but watch your step, make a sound and the Quiet Ones welcome you.

[previewyoutube=Ewkx5eBlOEs;full]https://youtu.be/yiC7Z7Ih27I [/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=8I2d0uk7u5c;full][/previewyoutube]

Now you've seen sound devices in use, you've seen the breathing mechanic, the sound-based AI enemies, the inventory system... now we'd like to share a few details on the save system (a common question we receive!)

Yes, you can manually save your game via our Phonographs.

We welcome you to indulge in the use of the Phonographs, a device for the mechanical recording and reproduction of sound. Invented by Thomas Edison, the American inventor who gave us the Electric light bulb, it transitioned into the gramophone, which led to what we still use today — the vinyl record player.

Our Phonographs offer safety, allowing you to catch your breath and save your game, listen to the recordings and unlock the mysteries lurking within the Sker Hotel. 

Upgrade your stay by adding the game to your Steam Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/826940

Now the gates are opening, we will see you soon.

Wales Interactive

notes.title: [Patched] Flickering Screens
notes.content:
Hey everyone

Just a quick update to let you know that Unity have now fixed an issue where some high-refresh monitor (120hz, 240hz etc) are experiencing flickering or stuttering. This is happening because of a bug in the game engine - Unity - which is not recognizing the refresh rate and is trying to force the refresh at what your Windows settings are telling it. 

Thank you all for your patience on this one!

[b]New fix for crashes (AMD laptops)[/b]
We also have a new fix for black screens and game crashes, specifically on AMD laptops...

Go to Device Manager (you can use Run and type devmgmt.msc or just search for Device Manager)
Go to Display Adapters
Right-click on the one that is NOT your AMD adapter, and choose 'disable device'

[b]Additional notes[/b]
If your game is crashing, it is likely your version of Windows doesn't have the codecs to play the video files. Please see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1107790/discussions/0/1866119961557741776/]this thread[/url] to fix this. 

Wales Interactive

notes.title: Korean Subtitles Revised
notes.content:
Hey everyone

Just a quick update here regarding Korean subtitles (and other languages)

We recognize that the subtitles across a few languages were poorly done and in no way was up to our usual standard of localization. We hired a new company to perform this task and they underdelivered. The languages most affected was Korean, and to a much lesser extent, German and Russian. In a recent patch, we revised the German subtitles. 

[h3]Revised Korean[/h3]
Thanks to this amazing community, we have enlisted the help of [b]Marshall[/b] to correct this. Marshall also helped with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/584980/Late_Shift/]Late Shift[/url] too!

[b]Note: [/b]Because we wanted to get this fix out ASAP, this is a first revision of the subtitles and minor tweaks may be needed in a smaller patch this week. We will continue to monitor this and update accordingly.

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
We are working with our Russian translator to update any minor mistakes that are currently in the game. 

We want to thank you for your continued support and please feel free to reach out to us [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1107790/discussions/0/1866119961557764472/]here[/url].

notes.title: Flickering Screen Fix
notes.content:
Hey everyone

Just a quick update here regarding an issue that some people are experiencing. 

We have found that players who are using a high-refresh monitor (120hz, 240hz etc) are experiencing some flickering or stuttering. This is happening because of a bug in the game engine - Unity - which is not recognizing the refresh rate and is trying to force the refresh at what your Windows settings are telling it. 

[h3]Temporary Fix[/h3]
We have released a patch that includes an option in the settings which allows you to choose the refresh rate. Please change this to the refresh rate of your monitor. Some users will also find going into Windowed mode helps. 

[b]Note: [/b]The bug also doesn't allow the engine to save this new option, so you will have to do this every time. 

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
We are working on a more permanent solution where the game automatically recognizes and changes this setting. We have also raised this issue with Unity. 

[h3]Additional notes[/h3]
If your game is crashing, it is likely your version of Windows doesn't have the codecs to play the video files. Please see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1107790/discussions/0/1866119961557741776/]this thread[/url] to fix this. 

Finally, we are addressing the known issues for poor localisation across several languages including Korean, German and more. Expect an update tomorrow 03/04.

Wales Interactive

notes.title: One-week until The Complex launch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36752512/aafc953c105a8ff03238974e14197c9765fefc27.gif[/img]

Hello everyone! You might remember us from our previous interactive movies [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/584980/Late_Shift/]Late Shift[/url] and The Bunker... maybe even from our upcoming survival horror [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/826940/Maid_of_Sker/]Maid of Sker[/url]. Well, Wales Interactive are here to reveal a brand new interactive movie that releases on PC, Mac, PS4, Xbox One and Switch on March 31st. 

To celebrate the launch, we're giving you 10% off pre-orders, making it cheaper than a cinema ticket - or if you're in London, about the same as a large box of popcorn! 
 
So here we go, let's kick this off with some details on The Complex :)

[previewyoutube=1flPHceAsXY;full][/previewyoutube]

After a major bio-weapon attack on London, two scientists find themselves in a locked-down laboratory with time, and air, running out. With choose-your-own-path style gameplay, your actions and your relationship with other characters will lead you to one of eight suspenseful endings.

[h2]The Story[/h2]
Having treated the victims of a chemical attack in the totalitarian state of Kindar, Dr Amy Tenant is a leader in the advancement of Nanocell Technology. Now, in London, news breaks of a blood-vomiting civilian whose identity is far from coincidental. Reunited with an old friend, Amy is trapped in an impenetrable HQ of laboratories—a womb of scientific advancement with a perilous secret.

[h2]Cast & Crew[/h2]
The Complex is written by Lynn Renee Maxcy, part of the Emmy award-winning writing team from The Handmaid’s Tale. The interactive movie stars Michelle Mylett (Letterkenny, Bad Blood), Kate Dickie (Game of Thrones, The Witch) and Al Weaver (Grantchester). Featuring guest acting performance by Twitch streamer and former Xbox UK presenter, Leah Viathan.

[h2]Relationship Tracking[/h2]
Throughout the game you will interact with characters and — depending on your choices — will either strengthen or weaken your relationship. The relationship scores are calculated from the start right through to the very end and will affect certain scenarios as well as having major consequences in the concluding scenes.

[h2]Personality Tracking[/h2]
For every decision you make, every interaction, your character’s personality is being tracked. At the end of each playthrough, you are rewarded with a Personality Score and a breakdown to see how you played the game. Discover the five basic dimensions of a personality; openness, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness and neuroticism. Which of those will your character play?

[h2]Features[/h2]
• A completely live action, cinematic interactive sci-fi thriller, filmed in the UK. Directed by Paul Raschid, and written by Lynn Renee Maxcy (The Handmaid's Tale - TV Series).
• Multi-optional storytelling with 8 different outcomes.
• Real-time Relationship Status Tracking that influences the story as you play.
• Real-time Personality Trait Tracking that evolves based on your choices.
• Starring Michelle Mylett (Letterkenny, Bad Blood), Kate Dickie (Game of Thrones, The Witch)
and Al Weaver (Grantchester)
• Guest acting performance by live streamer and presenter, Leah Viathan.
• Unlockable features include Skip Scene, Personality Assessment and a Hidden Event.
• Featuring a Pause Choices option for improved audience participation during live streams.

So what do you think?

Leave your comments below if you're excited!
